ideas.title: FBI's evidence sharing practices under scrutiny
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's refusal to share evidence with Minnesota officials in the Alex Pretti case and its implications for future investigations.
ideas.angle: The impact of the FBI's actions on state-level investigations
questions: What are the consequences of the FBI's refusal to share evidence?
How will this affect future investigations?
ideas.insight: The story would explore the tension between federal and state agencies in the context of the Alex Pretti investigation.

ideas.title: Minnesota's aggressive approach to fraud investigations
ideas.description: Examine the impact of Minnesota's fraud crackdown on vulnerable populations, such as disabled Medicaid recipients.
ideas.angle: The human cost of the state's efforts to combat fraud
questions: What are the consequences of the state's aggressive approach?
How effective is the approach in combating fraud?
ideas.insight: The story would analyze the data behind the state's efforts and the potential consequences for those affected.
